intro: Myanmar is rich in jade, gems, gas and farmland, but war has badly damaged its economy.

chapters.title: Resources
text: Myanmar produces most of the world's jadeite jade and famous rubies. It exports natural gas to Thailand and China, and rice, beans and clothing.

chapters.title: Crisis
text: Since 2021 many businesses have left, prices have soared, and millions have been pushed into poverty.

keyTerms.meaning: A hard green stone prized for carving.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Myanmar makes and sells to the world.
